eel.name: Steel Tread
eel.description: Gain a bit of knockback resistance as well as damage resistance against attacks that ragdoll you.

eel.name: Steel Scales
eel.description: You take an additional 5% less damage when your armor is broken.

eel.name: Turning of the Wheel
eel.description: After perfect dodging a swing or critical attack, step backwards and ramp up your swingspeed.

eel.name: Steelvessel
eel.description: Landed attacks deal posture damage but when guard broken take massive damage. Posture gain on parry is reduced.

eel.name: Steel Grip
eel.description: When you are blockbroken, negate it and set your posture to 80%.

eel.name: Training Wheels
eel.description: Increase the amount of parry frames you have by 20%.

collapse.name: Collapsed Lung
collapse.description: Block breaking an opponent closes off their ability to Vent for 8s, with this duration scaling with Strength. PvE enemies instead get Collapsed.

collapse.name: Braced Collapse
collapse.description: After being block broken, the next attack to hit you deals reduced damage.

rage.name: Amplified Rage
rage.description: Amped now grants you an additional +10% weapon damage. Also self-damage and cooldown by 3x.

rage.name: Kj's Courage
rage.description: Gain 10% more Knowledge from all sources, rounded down.

rage.name: Mirage Clone
rage.description: Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire.

rage.name: Explosive Rage
rage.description: Causing explosion will make your puppets go into a frenzy, speeding up and dealing 50% more damage.

rage.name: Primal Rage
rage.description: If you are below 50%, unleash your rage and increase the amount of damage you deal for 25 seconds as well as being able to see enemy health when you hit them.

rage.name: Righteous Rage
rage.description: [In Berserk State] You deal increased damage the lower your health is.

rage.name: Relentless Barrage
rage.description: Every swing from Rapid Punches deals more posture than the last. At max punch stacks enables hyperarmor during the barrage.

rage.name: Barrage Mastery
rage.description: For every Ether Erudite stack you have, gain one extra orb whenever you fire your Ether Barrage.

rage.name: True Mirage Clone
rage.description: Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire.

rage.name: Enrage

objectives: Wipe with the Strange Merchant Memento

rage.description: Whenever you stun an opponent who's taunted with Encore, enrage them.

rage.name: Rage Amp
rage.description: At 2 or more combat tags, your critical now applies anti-heal while also increases the size and damage of your critical. This scales with the amount of combat tags you have.

piercing.name: Armor Piercing
piercing.description: [Guns] Your gun attacks now ignore 10% of an opponent's blunt armor. Applied Multiplicatively before PEN is applied.

piercing.name: Piercing Metal
piercing.description: Deal additional armor damage to enemies per metal rod affecting them.

piercing.name: Piercing Blow
piercing.description: Attacks that break an opponent's block ignore their Armor resistances.

piercing.name: Piercing Shot
piercing.description: Activate to make your next critical attack with any gun have 100% chip and shatter your opponent's armor for a few seconds, making them take increased PEN from all sources.

piercing.name: Piercing Will
piercing.description: When your sanity is below 35%, gain up to +15% PEN on your attacks. Starting at 5% PEN, the lower your sanity, the higher your PEN.

lose your mind.name: Lose Your Mind
lose your mind.description: Deal more damage the more insane you are. Grants +15% damage at maximum insanity.

showstopper.name: Showstopper
showstopper.description: When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing.

brick.name: Brick Wall
brick.description: You refuse. You cannot be knocked off your feet until you are knocked completely Unconscious. Also reduces the duration of Knockdown.

underdog.name: Underdog
underdog.description: You deal 2.5% more damage to those with higher HP than you, scaling up to 4% at 60 WLL. Additionally, you deal +10% more damage to physically larger foes.

collapsed.name: Collapsed Lung
collapsed.description: Block breaking an opponent closes off their ability to Vent for 8s, with this duration scaling with Strength. PvE enemies instead get Collapsed.

heretic.name: Heretic's Sutra

quests: Have had tier 1 insanity (shivering), and talk to Kasen, located in Layer 2 Floor 1.

heretic.description: A chant that steers you into the state of Insanity for 20 seconds.

heretic.name: Heretic's Sacrifice
heretic.description: A chant that heavily sacrifices your sanity to regain a bit of health.
